title: Validation
purpose: Defines repository validation during repo-spec formation.

normative_requirements.text: The repository shall provide one validation entry point.
The validation entry point shall be shell-only and shall not rely on external dependencies.
The validation entry point shall enforce JSON Schema conformance.
The validation entry point shall enforce manifest completeness.
The validation entry point shall enforce unique specification IDs.
The validation entry point shall enforce resolvable references.
The validation entry point shall enforce acyclic dependencies.
The validation entry point shall enforce generated-document freshness.
The validation entry point shall enforce clean failure behavior.
The validation entry point shall not check formatting, prose quality, Git workflow, hosting-platform behavior, product-spec definitions, or source-code behavior.
